source: Quest Helper files it under miniquests, but the game and the OSRS Wiki count it as a members' quest (Novice, no quest points; Quests/List, November 2026), so only its type and difficulty are changed here. Its guide is unchanged.

items: Nails (bring more in case you fail with some) (14)

st.t: Talk to Marlo in north-east Varrock.
s: What kind of favour do you want me to do?
Tell me more about the job.
Tell me where he lives, and I'll do the job.

st.t: Talk to Old Man Yarlo in south-east Varrock, west of Aubury's Rune Shop.
Clear all 7 broken pieces in Old Man Yarlo's house: the campbed, the rotten carpet, 2 stools, 2 tables and the chair. Long-press each one and choose Remove or Demolish.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo again after removing all the broken furniture.
s: Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.

st.t: Rebuild the furniture in Old Man Yarlo's house: the carpet (3 bolts of cloth), 2 stools (1 plank, 2 nails each), 2 tables (3 planks, 4 nails each) and the chair (2 planks, 2 nails). Bring a few spare nails. Long-press each spot, choose Build, then pick the first option in the list.
Search the crates marked with a black symbol, just west of the range in Old Man Yarlo's house, for 3 waxwood logs.
Talk to the Sawmill operator north-east of Varrock to make waxwood planks.
s: I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.

st.t: Build the waxwood bed in Old Man Yarlo's house. Pick the first option in the build menu.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo again after rebuilding the furniture.
Talk to Marlo in north-east Varrock to complete the quest.
s: Yeah, what have you got for me?

i: Nails (bring more in case you fail with some) (14)
